project.purpose: First-level Recursive LEGO R2.1 SOURCE semantics for distinct descriptive, governance, reconciliation and durable accounting responsibilities. No trading or provider grant.

nodes.label: PublicMarketSnapshotQualification
nodes.responsibility: Evaluate one market public-stream/snapshot observation without access to private accounts or trading effects
nodes.authority: Capital domain's bounded source contract, not provider execution truth
inputs: public market stream snapshot with explicit sequence/time/source fields
outputs: bounded public stream standing or explicit invalid/unknown result
nodes.behavioralContract: Missing/invalid fields and incorrect source readiness cannot imply a live tradable market; public visibility is not private account or authorization evidence.
acceptance: Owner native public-stream tests reject malformed snapshots and measure source metadata.

nodes.label: FactorProxyDependenceMeasurement
nodes.responsibility: Measure factor-proxy dependence from caller-supplied exact historical observations without claiming causal alpha
nodes.authority: Capital domain's bounded source contract, not provider execution truth
inputs: explicit paired asset/proxy histories and observation assumptions
outputs: scoped proxy-dependence/factor observatory evidence with qualifications
nodes.behavioralContract: Correlation/proxy exposure is not a forecast, causal factor or execution signal; missing observations remain incomplete.
acceptance: Factor consumer contract and portfolio risk tests differentiate measurement from trading or inferred signals.

nodes.label: PortfolioExposureLedger
nodes.responsibility: Compose native Account durable paper buy/sell closes, source-bound Markets marks and existing Risk/Governance without another engine
nodes.authority: Capital domain's bounded source contract, not provider execution truth
inputs: caller position/factor observations with owner risk-budget registration
operator-bound ETF close snapshot and offline Account receipt OR direct paper PostgreSQL account/session readback
outputs: native exposure and Governance risk limit evaluation
reconciled net equity, cash, payables, sale receivables, position value and persistence readback standing
nodes.behavioralContract: NAV exactly equals settled cash minus purchase payables plus sale receivables plus marked holdings; sale receivable is not free cash; SQL read path checks stored request digest and receipt identity; UNSET budget remains INCOMPLETE.
acceptance: Owner tests construct exposure ledger from explicit loadings and reject incomplete risk inputs.

Native tests compose real PostgreSQL paper close with Markets source admission, Risk exposure and Governance incomplete budget; negative cases alter NAV, payable, shares, source identity and settlement maturity
Disposable PostgreSQL writes buy and sell, read-only readback confirms request SHA, rejects tampered DB row and excludes unsettled sale receivables from free cash.

r21Contract.I: Account receipt or PostgreSQL read-only account/session SELECT, admitted Markets ETF snapshot, existing owner risk budget
r21Contract.O: native exposure, Governance limit evaluation, cash/payable/sale receivable/NAV, persistence-readback status
r21Contract.S: No new state; Accounting retains PostgreSQL and Risk is pure given verified receipt
r21Contract.pre: matched operator source and instrument/price session, stored request digest and data types valid, sale receivables have explicit maturity
r21Contract.post: NAV=cash-payables+sale_receivables+marked holdings; unencumbered cash excludes receivables; native Risk/Governance only
r21Contract.inv: no fill inference from adjusted historical NAV; unavailable real provider/source evidence never promotes authority
r21Contract.eff: Offline mode reads local files; Account SQL read uses read-only PostgreSQL transaction; no financial writes
r21Contract.c: O(k) portfolio positions/pending liabilities plus indexed O(log N) receipt lookup in Accounting; excludes network/SQL latency
r21Contract.epsilon: integer-cent conservation exact; provider data and risk tolerance UNKNOWN
r21Contract.prov: Accounting DB committed request SHA, Markets operator-bound snapshot SHA, no external market truth attestation
r21Contract.unfold: Accounting.read_committed_paper_close/receipt -> Markets.admit_etf_eod_snapshot -> Risk.review_paper_close_risk -> native Governance report; consumed Human/Agent guide

nodes.label: PortfolioCounterfactualComposition
nodes.responsibility: Calculate what-if portfolio position changes and evaluate the named constraint gate over an existing exposure ledger
nodes.authority: Capital domain's bounded source contract, not provider execution truth
inputs: qualified exposure ledger and proposed hypothetical portfolio delta
outputs: counterfactual states and applicable constraint-gate results
nodes.behavioralContract: What-if alternatives are descriptive, not broker instructions, trade rankings or authorization; use explicit deltas and state.
acceptance: Native portfolio counterfactual tests consume exposure-ledger results and reject invalid conditions.

nodes.label: NonLiveExecutionPolicyAdmission
nodes.responsibility: Evaluate whether one configured Capital execution lane is non-live or otherwise source-policy admissible before permitting any later provider effect
nodes.authority: Capital domain's bounded source contract, not provider execution truth
inputs: current lane, source policy, explicit account and permission facts
outputs: bounded allow/reject policy decision with reason
nodes.behavioralContract: Unknown/unqualified live-account facts never mean permission; external-write and non-live gates must reject forbidden permission, role or account mode.
acceptance: Native execution-policy tests falsify forbidden live/effect-policy paths and preserve no-order guarantee.

nodes.label: AmbiguousExecutionReconciliation
nodes.responsibility: Reconcile one prior order intent with provider-observed order/fill standing, leaving outcome UNKNOWN when authoritative evidence is incomplete
nodes.authority: Capital domain's bounded source contract, not provider execution truth
inputs: exact client order/intent identity, provider account snapshot and fill evidence
outputs: bounded FIX-like standing, fill accounting and safe reservation resolution recommendation
nodes.behavioralContract: Missing order snapshot cannot imply no effect; blind retry/void is not authorized without terminal fully reconciled fills or authoritative negative lookup.
acceptance: Owner native execution-reconciliation tests exercise absent, ambiguous and partial-fill cases with synthetic provider results.

nodes.label: DurableCapitalReservationLedger
nodes.responsibility: Represent durable capital reservation instruction and reconcile historically committed transfer effects across accounting backends
nodes.authority: Capital domain's bounded source contract, not provider execution truth
inputs: typed account namespace, reservation binding, durable transfers and observations
outputs: type-safe accounting instruction and reconciliation standing with exact operation identity
nodes.behavioralContract: Unknown commit state cannot become available funds; source SQLite and PostgreSQL backends are implementations, not a license to claim live writer switchover.
acceptance: Native accounting substrate/durable tests protect stable identities and replay of synthetic reservations.

nodes.label: ProspectiveStrategyEvidenceValidation
nodes.responsibility: Check whether prospective research results obey the named decision date and post-decision session boundary
nodes.authority: Capital domain's bounded source contract, not provider execution truth
inputs: decision instant/timezone, observed post-decision sessions, prospective result evidence
outputs: bounded prospective validation standing with explicit missing time periods
nodes.behavioralContract: Historical/backfilled data cannot impersonate true prospective evidence; verification says nothing about live future edge.
acceptance: Native prospective-validation tests reject wrong session/time boundaries.

nodes.label: StrategicContributionOnlyAllocation
nodes.responsibility: Project exact contribution-only allocation from explicit user targets and protected cash reserves
nodes.authority: Finance Portfolio source and caller-supplied policy; Risk, Governance and Trading retain independent authority
inputs: USD integer cents cash, reserve, contribution, holdings and target weights in integer basis points
outputs: deterministic read-only allocation proposal, projected holdings and explicit unverified/risk-unknown standings
nodes.behavioralContract: Conservation, no-selling, protected reserve and exact normalized target weights; no trade order, advice, inferred return or execution rights
acceptance: Existing Finance native suite, exact integer conservation/property matrix, and real stdin CLI consumer with negative invalid-document cases

r21Contract.I: strict caller USD minor-unit holdings/reserve/contribution and exact target bps
r21Contract.O: exact integer projected holdings and unverified research-only receipt
r21Contract.pre: valid asset identities, reserve funded, contribution <= unprotected cash, weights sum to 10000
r21Contract.post: allocated contribution exact, no holdings decrease, cash after >= protected reserve
r21Contract.inv: int64 money bounds; integer apportionment; no risk/financial-write authorization
r21Contract.epsilon: not applicable to arithmetic; market returns UNKNOWN
r21Contract.prov: source path, exact example, owner tests and real CLI; external account valuations UNATTESTED
r21Contract.unfold: parse and validate -> integer deficits -> largest remainder apportion -> project and mark unknown

nodes.label: FrozenExperimentProtocolReview
nodes.responsibility: Freeze a research policy before holdout, bind later candidate source-replay to that frozen policy identity, and classify prospective evidence without financial execution
nodes.authority: Finance Research source-only evidence declaration; external providers and independent verifiers remain authoritative
inputs: pre-holdout point-in-time research plan with candidate policy fingerprint, data snapshot identities, prospective partitions and trial count
source-replay candidate manifest plus post-freeze source and holdout bytes, reported evaluation time
outputs: composed source-replayed economic summary with explicit UNKNOWN, REJECTED or review-required provenance state
nodes.behavioralContract: Candidate weights, benchmark expense, hypothesis, trial family and freeze time must match the frozen policy digest. Later input/return bytes are recomputed by existing Finance Research candidate evaluator. Missing external source and independent reproduction attestations remain UNKNOWN, no allocation/order authority.
acceptance: Native source tests vary data release time, holdout overlap, independent reproduction and experiment-family multiplicity.

Native combined CLI consumer verifies precommit fingerprint against replayed candidate, rejects weight/trial mutation and recommitted false returns, and retains UNKNOWN for incomplete holdout or unattested independent reproduction.

r21Contract.I: precommitted research plan, canonical pre-holdout candidate policy (weight, benchmark expense, hypothesis, freeze instant, trial count, currency, cost coverage), later frozen receipt and externally supplied candidate source/holdout byte streams
r21Contract.O: sha256-bound policy fingerprint, frozen plan receipt, native source-replayed candidate result and compositional review with UNKNOWN/REJECTED; no trading or capital rights
r21Contract.S: Unit, pure Python source; external durable artifact identity belongs to Runtime
r21Contract.pre: declared source vintage available at freeze; disjoint UTC train/validation/holdout; configDigest exactly equals canonical candidate policy fingerprint; holdout source/manifest references are postfreeze evidence, not frozen training data
r21Contract.post: source model recomputes candidate returns from committed bytes and fixed policy; altered weights/trials/false recomputed returns rejected; incomplete holdout or independent reproduction UNKNOWN; no source evaluator can promote a financial order
r21Contract.inv: no duplicate return arithmetic, no own storage, broker, credential, model authority or additional Agent; declarations never elevate source/provider authenticity, effect rights or independent replication standing
r21Contract.c: fingerprint O(k) candidate policy serialization; composed evaluation O(n) postfreeze source rows and native candidate arithmetic; finite resource admission UNKNOWN
r21Contract.epsilon: exact source identity SHA-256 and Decimal context only; future returns, market authenticity, external time attestation and independent significance UNKNOWN
r21Contract.prov: current Capital source/native tests, candidate SHA256 raw-hex source/holdout bytes, protocol sha256: hex digest, UNKNOWN independent provider and preregistration witness
r21Contract.unfold: experiment_protocol.candidate_policy_digest -> freeze_experiment_plan -> experiment_protocol.review_replayed_candidate -> investment_candidate.evaluate_investment_candidate -> assess_holdout_evidence; scripts/run-finance-lego and native consumer tests

edges.label: constraint gate calls Capital policy decision

slices.label: PublicMarketsAndDescriptivePortfolioAnalysis
acceptance: Native source-bound tests verify no inference from observations to trading authority; consumer behavior outside current test set remains UNKNOWN.

slices.label: ExecutionSafetyAndAccounting
acceptance: Policy/reconciliation/accounting implementations have separate native tests, but provider account acceptance and Windows/Linux installed state are not claimed.

slices.label: InvestmentFirstStrategicAllocation
acceptance: Read-only investment allocation CLI and conservation tests are source-realized; live effect authority stays NONE.

gaps: Actual live/restricted provider account state and effect authority are not read or modified by this phase.
Source/consumer paths are native syntactic evidence only; no full dynamic consumer closure, installed currentness or model-to-code formal proof.
Remaining Capital interfaces may require deeper independent decomposition; 8 first-level source candidates are not exhaustive or a global LEGO count.
